# TopTen.one

> Public rankings where money, not an algorithm, picks #1

TopTen.one runs 72 public rankings - X accounts, footballers, billionaires,
crypto coins, cities, actors and more - where positions are decided by one
thing only: how much money has been paid towards each name. No algorithm, no
editors, no votes. Every ranking orders its listings by the total amount
paid, and the page says so out loud.

Anyone can add a name to any ranking for free; a listing appears once a
payment lands on it. The minimum payment is $2, payments go through Stripe,
and they are final: they buy a position on a public ranking - not an
investment, not a vote, not an endorsement. The closest battles - where the
smallest sum flips a #1 - are shown on the front page, along with what just
happened and what is trending over seven days.

The site is a fast static page, prerendered from the live rankings and
rebuilt as the money moves. It is Swiss made and available worldwide.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://topten.one/): the question, every ranking shelved by category, the closest battles
- [Find](https://topten.one/find/): search anyone or anything across all 72 rankings
- [About](https://topten.one/about.html): what the site is and how it works
- [Terms](https://topten.one/terms.html): terms of service
- [Privacy](https://topten.one/privacy.html): privacy policy
